## First and last GEOGRAPHY array elements
# Sources: ARRAY_FIRST and ARRAY_LAST in
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/array_functions.md.
# ST_EQUALS checks the selected point without depending on its WKT formatting.

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ARRAY_FIRST([ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(30, 40)]), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ARRAY_LAST([ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(30, 40)]), ST_GEOGPOINT(30, 40))
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_LAST(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST([CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20)])
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_LAST([ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY)])
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST(ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>[])
=> error:

SELECT ARRAY_LAST(ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>[])
=> error:
